headline: Operating profit recovers while per-share earnings fall
summary_short: Consolidated revenue was KRW 604.3B and operating profit KRW 33.2B, while EPS was KRW 286, down 69.6% q/q on the shard.
summary_long: Third-party coverage of the filing puts consolidated revenue at KRW 604.3B and operating profit at KRW 33.2B. EPS of KRW 286 compares with KRW 940 in the prior quarter. Year-over-year growth rates were not stated consistently across sources, so no y/y delta is shown. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
